cases.title: Logo completes then game remains on white screen

symptomFingerprint.primary: startup reaches/passes logo then white screen and does not progress into normal game flow
secondary: recenter/input path may still respond while presentation/game progression is stuck
logSignals: correlate game/host/watchdog session timeline around first post-logo Present and stereo transport activation

knownGood: a9abb85702925aaa09ca85581423eb9766c2adb3 — logo/menu/car/course/race rendered; later theater-only VR defect remained

rootCause.summary: D3D9Ex synchronous CreateDevice-thread stereo installation called EnsureStereoResources before the promoted device was returned to OutRun, allocating/mutating private RT/depth resources before fresh-device initialization completed.

fixReferences: 986f0d5794476056ef4bea08c6ac3c0d1f5f01d2 — historical protection: defer stereo resources until first successful game Present
341bd8027b9595f43c89e31ae1f9cf8783751faa — integrated current-focus reconstruction plus deterministic guard

cases.title: Startup crash inside canonical SpriteNode queue entry after VR HUD semantic hook install

symptomFingerprint.primary: Immediate 0xC0000005 access violation inside OR2006C2C.EXE SpriteNode queue-entry instruction block after VRHudQueueSemanticBridge installs.
secondary: crash occurs before meaningful stereo runtime progression

knownGood: Any candidate where production code does not install a mid-hook at RVA 0x2D734; runtime verification still required for current fix.

rootCause.summary: Production SafetyHookMid installed at canonical queue-entry RVA 0x2D734. Two independent real crashes resumed inside that relocated entry instruction sequence (0x2D738 and 0x2D73E), proving this entry hook boundary unsafe.

fixReferences: vr-d3d9ex-candidate/VR-HUDQUEUE-ENTRY-CRASH-559eb670 — remove 0x2D734 mid-hook; lazily begin queue semantic ownership at first per-node hook RVA 0x2D762; keep epilogue 0x2DCB4
revalidationTriggers: any production hook added within the canonical SpriteNode queue entry/prologue 0x2D734..0x2D74A
any change to SpriteNode semantic queue lifetime/ownership

static: require semantic queue scope to start lazily at first per-node hook 0x2D762
build Win32 active game DLL and package
strict canonical EXE byte contract remains valid for static reverse-analysis anchors
runtime: confirm startup passes the prior crash point without OR2006C2C.EXE+0x2D738/0x2D73E exception
confirm HUD semantic path becomes active and collect standardized OutRun2_VR_ANALYZE_*.zip
